meta.title: JEE Main coaching in Pune | D-SAP Ghule Tutorials
meta.description: JEE Main coaching with monthly full mocks on a screen like the real exam, chapter tests and Kota faculty. Centres in New Sangvi and Wakad.

intro: JEE Main decides admission to NITs, IIITs and many other engineering colleges, and students who score high enough go on to sit JEE Advanced for the IITs.

intro.text: Our programmes prepare for JEE Main from the first month.

sections.heading: What JEE Main asks
body: The paper has {{fact:exam.jee-main#questions}} questions in {{fact:exam.jee-main#hours}} hours, {{fact:exam.jee-main#perSubject}} each in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. In each subject, {{fact:exam.jee-main#mcq}} questions are multiple choice and {{fact:exam.jee-main#numerical}} need a number as the answer. Every question must be attempted.
It is held twice a year, in {{fact:exam.jee-main#sessions}}. Students can sit both, and the better score counts.

sections.heading: How we prepare students for it

body.text: Every month there is a full JEE Main mock of the same length, taken on our online portal, which works like the real exam screen.
Between mocks, a test after every chapter and a weekly practice sheet keep the work steady. Each test comes back with a personal analysis, so your child knows which chapters to go back to.

questions.q: When should my child start preparing?

a.text: Class 11 is the usual start, since the paper covers Class 11 and Class 12. Our two-year programme starts in June after Class 10.

questions.a: Yes. In the multiple-choice questions, a wrong answer loses marks. Check the NTA information bulletin for the year, as the marking can change.
